title: Omwoyo Ogutatuumiddwa Mannya Eyayimirira Ku Ggwanga Eritali Mutuukirivu
intro: Mu mpapula za Quran, waliwo abantu abakuumibwa amannya gaabwe tusobole okufumiitiriza ku by’okuyiga byabwe. Emmeeme emu ng’eyo yazaalibwa mu ggwanga eryali ligaanye ababaka baalyo, naye ate omuntu ono ssekinnoomu yalina okukkiriza okukwekebwa okwabaawula. Okuzikirizibwa bwe kwali kugenda okutuuka, omuntu ono yayimirira mu nzikiriza yaabwe ey’ekyama. Osobola okuzuula omuntu ono ow’ekyama alabula abantu baabwe ng’ekiragiro ekisembayo tekinnakka?
clues: Nabeera mu bantu abaali beegaana enfunda eziwera ababaka Allah be yabatumira.
Okwawukanako n’eggwanga lyange, nategeera amazima omubaka bwe yatuuka n’obubonero obw’olwatu okuva eri Mukama wange.
Nnakweka okukkiriza kwange eri abanyigiriza, nga mmanyi nti bajja kuntuusaako obulabe singa bazuula enzikiriza yange.
Ekiragiro ky’okubonereza bwe kyasembera, nnalangirira mu lwatu obwesigwa bwange era ne ndabula abantu bange okwetaasa.
Nabajjukiza nti ndi mubaka eyesigika, sirina njawulo nabo abatumibwa emabegako, era nti tebalina kusinza okuggyako Allah.
Abantu bange banvunaana obulogo n’eddalu, naye ekibonerezo kye baalabulwa okukkakkana nga kibatuuseeko.
